title: 2187. Minimum Time to Complete Trips

examples.explanation: - At time t = 1, the number of trips completed by each bus are [1,0,0]. The total number of trips completed is 1 + 0 + 0 = 1. - At time t = 2, the number of trips completed by each bus are [2,1,0]. The total number of trips completed is 2 + 1 + 0 = 3. - At time t = 3, the number of trips completed by each bus are [3,1,1]. The total number of trips completed is 3 + 1 + 1 = 5. So the minimum time needed for all buses to complete at least 5 trips is 3.
There is only one bus, and it will complete its first trip at t = 2. So the minimum time needed to complete 1 trip is 2.
